mapper.select: SELECT SUM(AC.OUTLAY) AS OUTLAY, DATE_FORMAT(AC.PAYMENT_TIME, '%Y-%m-%d') AS PAYMENT_TIME, SDV.VALUE_NAME AS X_AXIS FROM account_cost AC LEFT JOIN sys_dict_value SDV ON SDV.DICT_KEY = 'WEEK_DAY' AND SDV.VALUE = WEEKDAY(STR_TO_DATE(AC.PAYMENT_TIME, '%Y-%m-%d')) + 1 WHERE 1 = 1 AND AC.LOGIC_DEL = 0 AND AC.PAYMENT_SIGN = 'EXPENSES' AND AC.PAYMENT_TIME >= #{accountCostDto.paymentTimeFrom} AND AC.PAYMENT_TIME <= #{accountCostDto.paymentTimeTo} GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(AC.PAYMENT_TIME, '%Y-%m-%d')

SELECT SUM(AC.OUTLAY) AS OUTLAY, DATE_FORMAT(AC.PAYMENT_TIME, '%Y-%m-%d') AS PAYMENT_TIME, DATE_FORMAT(AC.PAYMENT_TIME, '%Y-%m-%d') AS X_AXIS FROM account_cost AC WHERE 1 = 1 AND AC.LOGIC_DEL = 0 AND AC.PAYMENT_SIGN = 'EXPENSES' AND YEAR(AC.PAYMENT_TIME) = #{accountCostDto.year} AND MONTH(AC.PAYMENT_TIME) = #{accountCostDto.month} GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(AC.PAYMENT_TIME, '%Y-%m-%d')

SELECT SUM(AC.OUTLAY) AS OUTLAY, DATE_FORMAT(AC.PAYMENT_TIME, '%Y-%m') AS PAYMENT_TIME, DATE_FORMAT(AC.PAYMENT_TIME, '%Y-%m') AS X_AXIS FROM account_cost AC WHERE 1 = 1 AND AC.LOGIC_DEL = 0 AND AC.PAYMENT_SIGN = 'EXPENSES' AND YEAR(AC.PAYMENT_TIME) = #{accountCostDto.year} GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(AC.PAYMENT_TIME, '%Y-%m')
